summary: CRT file seek (lseek) via SetFilePointer: validates the CRT handle index, positions the OS handle with SetFilePointer, maps OS errors to CRT errno via ErrorIDLookupTable (writing errno=9 EBADF for an invalid handle), clears the EOF tracking bit (bit 1) on success, and returns the new file pointer.

operations.description: Resolve the OS handle value for CRT handle index a1 via sub_595A1F(a1).
Guard: when the resolved handle is -1 (invalid), write errno 9 (EBADF) to the TLS slot via TLSOffsetGetter() and return -1.
Invoke SetFilePointer(handle, lDistanceToMove, 0, dwMoveMethod) and store the result as v4.
Set LastError = GetLastError() when v4 is -1 (0xFFFFFFFF), otherwise LastError = 0.
On LastError nonzero, map the OS error to CRT errno via ErrorIDLookupTable(LastError) and return -1.
On success, clear the EOF tracking bit: *(BYTE*)(dword_8D4920[a1>>5] + 36*(a1&0x1F) + 4) &= ~2u.
Return the new file pointer v4 on success.
Called by sub_58C724, sub_58CA19, sub_58E290, sub_595AF9 and sub_59797B to position file handles during read/write/seek paths.
